description: MATLAB Air Traffic Simulation provides a MATLAB framework with traffic-simulation and control layers for evaluating automated air-traffic-control algorithms using ADS-B inputs. The provider is RebekaJager repository. Geographical and temporal coverage: The framework accepts historical or real-time traffic sources and synthetic scenarios; no fixed geographic coverage is claimed. The linked provider page supplies the access route and documentation; the resource payload was not retrieved. The licence is MIT. The described material is available without a stated fee. Caveats: The page establishes existence and purpose, but neither completeness nor fitness for a particular simulation was independently tested. For simulation, the documented contents can support transport network modelling and capacity planning. This use is an interpretation of the metadata, not a tested integration. It is conceptually related to model-bluesky, which supplies a comparison or modelling context; compatibility is not asserted.
